_about: Ground truth for tests/fixtures/manitou.test.js. Units were produced by the parser, then cross-checked: each plate legend line (name + age, read from the plate page) was compared with the heading of the same unit in the report text (read from pages 12-24), two independent extractions of the same words; all 48 agree. The plate legend has no unit prose, so descriptions come from the report: reportStartsWith is the first words of each full description. Edit this file (not the test) when you verify or correct a unit.
source: OF-03-19 Geologic Map of the Manitou Springs 7.5-Minute Quadrangle, El Paso and Teller Counties, Colorado (Colorado Geological Survey, 2003). Public document: report pages 1-46 plus the plate as page 47.
